note: EXP 009's declarative active set, loaded through the harness kernel's harness.json loader (arms/harness-set.mjs). components[0] is infrastructure, loaded before any scheduled operation (the memory gate mlx.model injects); components[1..] are the six schedulable components, in the order the schedule generator draws from. A config here is a default; a run supplies the run-environment parts (mlx.model's pin, the memory gate's readers). Its sha256 goes into the pre-registration's file map.
